summary: Created mcp-server/tests/gui/project-list.test.ts with 8 passing jsdom/Vitest tests covering all 5 deliverable scenarios: (1) clickable link rendered for projects with repository_name — href contains encoded repo and slug, link text is project_name; (2) read-only name cell for null-repo projects — no <a> anchor rendered; (3) ProjectNameCache populated with composite repo/slug key for projects that have a repository, and NOT populated for null-repo projects; (4) action-menu-wrapper carries correct data-repo and data-slug attributes (non-empty repo and empty-string repo); (5) portal action handler skips and logs console.error when data-repo is empty, without calling API.deleteProject.

Key technical challenge: project-list.js accesses `localStorage` as a bare name inside vm.runInThisContext, which resolves against Node's global (not jsdom's window). Resolved by installing a lightweight in-memory localStorage stub on `global` before executing the script.
All 94 test files / 2859 tests pass with no regressions.

comments.note: project-list.js uses `localStorage` as a bare global name throughout the function body (lines 20-27, 315-318, 332, 346, 390-394). In a strict module context or future bundler setup this would need an explicit import or `window.localStorage` reference. Not a bug today, but worth noting for any planned ESM migration.

The `_projectListDocHandlerInstalled` flag is set directly on `document` (line 445 of project-list.js) rather than in module-level state. This leaks across test runs when the same jsdom document persists, which required defensive cleanup in the test harness. A closure variable or WeakMap would be safer.

No other test file in tests/gui/ exercises project-list.js. The new test file deliberately targets buildTable() outputs via renderProjectList() rather than extracting buildTable as a named export, keeping the test surface aligned with how other view tests work (e.g. client-rendering.test.ts).
